capabilities: Overwrite domain favicons with custom icons
Assign icons to URI schemes like mailto://
Disable favicons on individual links with a nofavicon alias
extras: The provider comparison table notes request limits and that only the link hostname is sent to the chosen provider. Developers are told how to opt out via the renderMarkdown method or a data-no-favicon attribute.
problem: Obsidian renders external links as plain text, so users cannot see at a glance which site a link points to without writing custom CSS.

relations.evidence: Works with: Admonition , RSS Reader and many more plugins.
Works with: Admonition , RSS Reader and many more plugins.

summary: Link favicon display plugin that shows a website's favicon next to external links without custom CSS.
